sentences.text:
Jaykumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 12
March, 2024

Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:21921
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 2147 of 2024
Applicant :- Jaykumar

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ashok Kumar,Chandra Prakash
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.1022 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S.- Kotwali Sadar, District- Lakhimpur Kheri.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant, who is the father-in-law of the deceased.

It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that on 11.10.2023, it was informed that the daughter of the informant was killed by the entire matrimonial family, the post-mortem report on record indicates the cause of death as anti-mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark visible on the neck of the deceased, two abraded contusion were seen on ear and the knee of the deceased.
Jaykumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Jaykumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the post-mortem report, which indicates the cause of death as anti-mortem hanging and there being no specific allegation against the applicant of causing physical or mental harassment to the deceased soon before her death in relation to demand of dowry at the instance of the applicant, the applicant, who is the father-in-law of the deceased and has no criminal history is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
As such, the applicant is enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant- Jaykumar be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
.
[Pankaj Bhatia,J.] Order Date :- 12.3.2024 -Amit K-  
Jaykumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
